=================================================================
PARACONSISTENT KERNEL — Belnap FOUR
=================================================================

Four values, and what negation does to each:
  T  → negation F    designated: True   dialetheic: False
  B  → negation B    designated: True   dialetheic: True
  N  → negation N    designated: False   dialetheic: False
  F  → negation T    designated: False   dialetheic: False

meet
         T   B   N   F
      T  T   T   N   N
      B  T   B   N   F
      N  N   N   N   N
      F  N   F   N   F

join
         T   B   N   F
      T  T   B   T   B
      B  B   B   B   B
      N  T   B   N   F
      F  B   B   F   F

B is the fixed point of negation, and it is where a contradiction is held
rather than exploded. N is the other fixed point, and holds nothing.
